text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Queen Elizabeth II Cup is right around the corner! Fine Motion asks her roommate, Air Groove, about the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove, who has run that race herself, explains that it's a proud and dignified race of enormous significance, and a special event very much befitting the word "queen" in its name.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I watch a broadcast of the race with Fine Motion, who is deeply moved by watching the runners vie desperately for victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Queen Elizabeth II Cup—Fine Motion commits the name to memory.
